    1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
    2: """
    3: S85 W12-ELIM-6 — Plan-layer PRDR consistency audit
    4: ====================================================
    5: 
    6: Gate: S85-W12-ELIM-6 ([AUDIT])
    7: 
    8: Pre-registered threshold (plan §W12-2 line 85):
    9:   PASS  iff  100% of pairs classified in {IMPLIES, CONTRADICTS,
   10:             INDEPENDENT-DECLARED, ORTHOGONAL}  AND  UNDECLARED = 0
   11:             AND  CONTRADICTS = 0.
   12:   FAIL  iff  CONTRADICTS >= 1.
   13:   INFO  iff  0 < UNDECLARED <= 0.05 * total_pairs  AND  CONTRADICTS = 0.
   14: 
   15: Output 4-tuple:
   16:   (value=<N_IMPLIES, N_CONTRADICTS, N_INDEPENDENT, N_UNDECLARED>,
   17:    scheme=plan-layer-prdr, convention=four-valued-predicate, L_max=n/a)
   18: 
   19: Classification: NON-PHONONIC (infrastructure / plan-file AST audit).
   20: 
   21: METHODOLOGY
   22: -----------
   23: The tool parses the 15 S85 wave plan files (W0, W1a, W1b, W1c, W2, W3, W4,
   24: W5, W6, W7, W8, W9, W10, W11, W13 — W12 excluded per plan line 104),
   25: extracts gate-block headings `## §W{i}-{n}. GATE_ID [— title]`, and
   26: matches each gate's `**Hypothesis**` block via tolerant regex.
   27: 
   28: Classification per pair (g_i, g_j):
   29:   1. Extract observable keywords + mechanism keywords from each hypothesis.
   30:   2. shared_obs = obs_i ∩ obs_j;  shared_mech = mech_i ∩ mech_j.
